programme.title: The mustard of Meus / De mosterd van Meus
programme.desc: Jeroen goes to Georgia, land of wine and honey. Cooking together and good food are an important part of daily life here. Jeroen meets special figures along the way such as the Botervrouwen in Adzjara and a 71-year-old honey climmer who wanted to harvest honey in an impressive way. Madloba, Georgia! / Jeroen trekt naar Georgië, land van wijn en honing. Samen koken en lekker eten zijn hier een belangrijk deel van het dagelijkse leven. Met de tips van chef Guram Baghdoshvili ontdekt Jeroen het hart van de Georgische keuken via de lokale bevolking. Van tenili, een vergeten kaastraditie, tot wijn uit ondergrondse kleivaten. Jeroen ontmoet onderweg bijzondere figuren zoals de botervrouwen in Adzjara en een 71-jarige honingklimmer die op indrukwekkende wijze wilde honing oogst. Madloba, Georgië!

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. programme.title: Fontana / Fontana
programme.desc: Born from the human sacrifice, the legendary tree of life promises immortality to anyone who drinks her juices. The search for a magical tree or more importantly, for his gift, obsessing with Tom for a thousand years. Told without the Chronological Order, the film of the fountain of life follows Tom's soul through three different incarnations, and during each of them, he desperately seeks to save the life of his soulmate, Iszi. First we get acquainted with Thomas, a conquistador in the 16th century serving Queen Isabel. In order to save Spain from the Inquisition, he was tasked with finding a tree, and referring to fearless soldiers in the enigmatic Mayan Jungle. In modern times, Dr. Tom Creo participates in a revolutionary research of brain tumors. He becomes obsessed with when his wife also disappears from the tumor, and she has only a few days of life. He is especially interesting to him, which gives incredible results in the treatment of that disease. As there is a little valuable time, Tom must hurry up with his research. Light years further, Tommy transferred the tree to the mystical part of the galaxy. As he remembers Izzie and his past lives, he travels to a fog who, once he arrives, promises both of both reinstatement and going to the world: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark Margolis, Stephen McHhattie directed: Darren Aronofsky / Rođeno iz ljudske žrtve, legendarno drvo života obećava besmrtnost svakomu ko popije njene sokove. Potraga za čarobnim stablom ili još važnije, za njegovim darom, opsjeda Toma tokom hiljadu godina. Ispričana bez hronološkoga reda, film Fontana života slijedi Tomovu dušu kroz tri različite inkarnacije, i tokom svake od njih on očajnički nastoji spasiti život svojoj srodnoj duši, Izzi. Prvo se upoznajemo s Tomasom, konkvistadorom u 16. stoljeću koji služi kraljici Isabel. Kako bi spasio Španjolsku od Inkvizicije, dobio je zadatak da nađe drvo, i upućuje se s neustrašivim vojnicima u zagonetnu majansku džunglu. U moderno doba dr. Tom Creo sudjeluje u revolucionarnom istraživanju tumora mozga. Postane opsjednut time kada se i njegova žena Izzie razboli od tumora, i ostane joj svega nekoliko dana života. Naročito mu je zanimljivo drvo koje daje nevjerojatne rezultate u liječenju te bolesti. Kako ima malo dragocjenog vremena, Tom mora požuriti sa svojim istraživanjem. Svjetlosnim godinama dalje, Tommy prenese drvo u mističan dio galaksije. Dok se sjeća Izzie i svojih prošlih života, putuje u maglicu koja, kada jednom stigne, obećava oboma ponovno rođenje i odlazak u svijet.Uloge: Hugh Jackman, Rachel Weisz, Ellen Burstyn, Mark Margolis, Stephen McHattie Režija: Darren Aronofsky

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 1: Croatia - France / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 1: Хърватия - Франция
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: Football: League 1 in France: 4 round: Marseille - Lorien / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 4 кръг: Марсилия - Лориен
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 1: Croatia - France / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 1: Хърватия - Франция
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. programme.title: Gold League / Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Golden League - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) Our guest Djordana Barbaric is a defectologist by profession, dedicated her life to helping, not only young people but many needy, especially the homeless people. Our second guest - Vinko Prizmic participated in more than 2000 rescue actions. He has been the principle of the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service for almost 20 years, and is greatly responsible for its success. Screenwriter: Zvonimir Varošanec Heads: Nada Šurjak and Zvonimir Varošanec Director: Mladen Šimunov Editor: Lidija Šprajc and Jasna Ceković R.: Mladen Simunov ... / Zlatna liga - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Naša gošća Đordana Barbarić po struci je defektologinja, svoj život posvetila je pomaganju, ne samo mladima već mnogim potrebitima, osobito beskućnicima. Naš drugi gost - Vinko Prizmić sudjelovao je u više od 2000 akcija spašavanja. Gotovo 20 godina bio je načelu Hrvatske gorske službe spašavanja te je uvelike zaslužan za njezin današnji uspjeh. Scenarist: Zvonimir Varošanec Voditelji: Nada Šurjak i Zvonimir Varošanec Redatelj: Mladen Šimunov Urednice: Lidija Šprajc i Jasna Ceković R.: Mladen Šimunov...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E09, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) Chef David Skoko takes us to an exciting gastronomic journey with its companion, red Retro Cooking Van. The dynamics of the modern life is fast, which means we don't always have the opportunity for long meals, so we will sometimes eat on the road. Street food or Street Food has become part of the vital culinary scene. But we often identify it with US or Asian cuisine. Can we also inspire street food? David travels by its beautiful and visits their friends, also some of our most important and most creative chefs, so together forces, with a lot of fun, tearing out the possibilities of local foods and seek recipes for our homemade street food. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E09, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Chef David Skoko vodi nas na uzbudljivo gastronomsko putovanje sa svojim suputnikom, crvenim retro kombijem za kuhanje. Dinamika suvremenoga života je brza, što znači da nemamo uvijek mogućnost za duge obroke pa ćemo ponekad i jesti na cesti. Ulična hrana ili street food postala je dio vitalne kulinarske scene. No često je poistovjećujemo samo s američkom ili azijskom kuhinjom. Možemo li se i mi inspirirati uličnom hranom? David putuje Lijepom Našom i posjećuje svoje prijatelje, ujedno neke od naših najvažnijih i najkreativnijih chefova, pa zajednički snagama, uz puno zabave, otkivaju mogućnosti lokalnih namirnica i traže recepte za našu domaću uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (Nature. Film, Croatia, 2017) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a gardener. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2017) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E137, featured series, Portugal, 2024) during Cacau's wedding feels tension. Because of Conyna, the arrival was tense Jaime and Salomao. Marco is preparing to meet her. Rui donates a susanna new clothes. Cacau receives Lucas's gift. Júlia presented David Salomau. Simonein and Laláin's arrival by the helicopter upset everything. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E137, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Tijekom Cacauina vjenčanja osjeća se napetost. Regina pokušava ubrzati obred, a Cacau prizna da se udaje za Marca kako bi uhvatila Cony koja je prijetila Tiagu i Marcu. Guto i Anita žele se suočiti s Cony, ali Marco ih spriječi. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E23, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E23, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... programme.title: In six fewer minutes / U šest manje koju minutu
programme.desc: Six less a minute - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2021) The documentary is engaged in the September war, one of the most important battles of the Homeland War. The Army under the command of Ratko Mladic then attacked with the entire military battalion, additionally increased territorial defense - humanity from the Knin and its surroundings, a total of more than five thousand soldiers, a column of T8 tanks, the most powerful tanks that the JNA had, and with a complete aircraft escort. The aim of this action was to exit the JNA to the sea, to connect their forces with the barracks in Šibenik, to occupy the city and thus intersect Croatia: Split and south are isolated and eventually lead to their fall. The young man started from two directions: most of the tanks and army came to the Sibenik Bridge, and the rest from the recently occupied Drnis. On the other hand, there was a city without weapons, but full of heroism. What happened then, as Sibenik defended itself and that, for the first time in the Homeland War, the Croatian forces went into a counter -attack, it is a miracle, a real EP. The documentary brings extremely dramatic and emotionally charged testimonies of people from the military and civilian sphere of life. The protagonists are people who were important actors of battle, whose life war had strongly influenced. They tell us about tense moments in Šibenik, Vodice and Drniš. They discover all the key moments in taking over the artillery battleships in the vicinity of Rogoznica and Zirje, where Croatian forces have reached the weapons with which the aggressor army opposed. R.: Ivan Zivkovic Zika ... / Šest manje koju minutu - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2021) Dokumentarni film bavi se Rujanskim ratom, jednom od najvažnijih bitaka Domovinskog rata. Armija pod zapovjedništvom Ratka Mladića tada je napala s cijelim vojnim bataljonom, dodatno pojačanim teritorijalnom obranom - ljudstvom s područja Knina i okolice, ukupno više od pet tisuća vojnika, kolonom tenkova T8, najsnažnijim tenkovima koje je JNA imala, te s kompletnom avionskom pratnjom. Cilj ove akcije bio je izlazak JNA na more, da se njihove snage spoje s vojarnama u Šibeniku, zauzmu grad te tako presijeku Hrvatsku: Split i jug izoliraju te na kraju dovedu i do njihovog pada. Mladić je krenuo iz dva smjera: glavnina tenkova i vojske je došla na Šibenski most, a ostatak iz netom okupiranog Drniša. Na drugoj strani je stajao grad bez naoružanja, ali pun junaštva. Ono što se tada ipak dogodilo, kako se Šibenik obranio i kako su, prvi put u Domovinskom ratu, hrvatske snage krenule u protunapad, pravo je čudo, pravi ep. Dokumentarni film donosi iznimno dramatična i emocionalno nabijena svjedočanstva ljudi iz vojne i civilne sfere života. Protagonisti su ljudi koji su bili važni akteri bitke, na čiji je život rat snažno utjecao. Govore nam o napetim trenucima u Šibeniku, Vodicama i Drnišu. Otkrivaju sve ključne trenutke u preuzimanju topničkih bitnica u okolici Rogoznice i Žirja, gdje su hrvatske snage došle do oružja s kojim su se suprotstavile agresorskoj vojsci. R.: Ivan Živković Žika...

programme.title: Living dead diary / Dnevnik živih mrtvaca
programme.desc: The Diary of the Dead - (Horor, USA, 2007) The master of horror returns to the type of filmmaking, which he began and the genre he invented. In his first independent zombie film after more than twenty years, George A. Romero brings us back to the very beginning of the epidemic of the living dead. Jason Creed and a small team of filmmakers are in the Pennsylvania Forests and shoot Ultrajufin horror film when they hear the scary news that the dead began to revive. Under the guidance of Jason's girlfriend Debre, the scared young filmmakers head to a friend's old house on wheels to try to get back to the only safety they know: their homes. But it is impossible to escape from that crisis, and they no longer have homes that they could return to. Everything they rely on, all that is most precious to them, falls apart as the monster of the living dead begins to spread. Jason documents true horrors in a tense style of a subjective camera that enhances the reality of any encounter. Even when his friends begin to die, even when they are attacked by hungry corpses, Jason continues to shoot and become obsessive, unwavering around in the middle of chaos. The government first denies and then promises to suppress the crisis, but it cannot. Technology cancels. Communication with the rest of the world becomes impossible. Jason and the rest of his team end up alone, a handful of lucky ones who are surviving, who can only rely on themselves if they want to stay alive. The last of them is a safe port has been established by a rich house, but their refuge is transformed into a trap from which there is no escape. During all this, the cameras do not stop shooting and records every detail for future generations ... If anyone survives. R.: George A. Romero Ul.: Michelle Morgan (Debra), Joshua Close (Jason Creed), Shawn Roberts (Tony), Amy Lalonde (Tracy Thurman), Joe Dinicol (Eliot) ... / Diary of the Dead - (horor, SAD, 2007) Majstor horora vraća se vrsti filmskog stvaralaštva koju je započeo i žanru koji je izumio. U svom prvom nezavisnom zombi filmu poslije više od dvadeset godina, George A. Romero vraća nas na sam početak epidemije živih mrtvaca. Jason Creed i mala ekipa studenata filmaša nalaze se u šumama Pennsylvanije i snimaju ultrajeftin horor film kada čuju zastrašujuću vijest da su mrtvi počeli oživljavati. Pod vodstvom Jasonove djevojke Debre, prestrašeni mladi filmaši zapute se u prijateljevoj staroj kući na kotačima kako bi se pokušali vratiti jedinoj sigurnosti koju poznaju: svojim domovima. Ali od te krize nemoguće je pobjeći, a oni više nemaju domove u koje bi se mogli vratiti. Sve na što se oslanjaju, sve što im je najdragocjenije, raspada se dok se pošast živih mrtvaca počinje širiti. Jason dokumentira istinite užase u napetom stilu subjektivne kamere koji pojačava stvarnost svakog susreta. Čak i kada njegovi prijatelji počnu ginuti, čak i kad ih gdje god stanu napadaju gladni hodajući leševi, Jason nastavlja snimati i postaje opsesivno, nepokolebljivo oko usred kaosa. Vlada prvo poriče, a zatim obećava da će suzbiti krizu, ali ne može. Tehnologija otkazuje. Komunikacija s ostatkom svijeta postaje nemoguća. Jason i ostatak njegove ekipe završavaju sami, šačica sretnika koji su preživjeli, koji se mogu osloniti samo na sebe ako žele ostati živi. Posljednja im je sigurna luka utvrđena bogataška kućerina, ali njihovo se utočište pretvara u zamku iz koje nema bijega. Tijekom svega toga, kamere ne prestaju snimati i bilježe svaku pojedinost za buduće naraštaje... ako itko preživi. R.: George A. Romero Ul.: Michelle Morgan (Debra), Joshua Close (Jason Creed), Shawn Roberts (Tony), Amy Lalonde (Tracy Thurman), Joe Dinicol (Eliot)...

programme.title: Two stories about Davor / Dvije priče o Davoru
programme.desc: Two stories about Davor - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2023) Most people in Croatia are probably unknown that the official, unified version of the Croatian anthem "Our Beautiful Homeland" was first publicly performed in Slavonski Brod, 1896, on the occasion of the great and festive celebration of the 25th anniversary of the Croatian Singing Society Davor. The society was founded in 1871, on the wave of the already existing and active European trend of choral singing, with the first in Croatia. It is, therefore, a cultural phenomenon that has been in our country for over 160 years, and in some countries in Europe and longer. But this history is part of just one of the possible stories of the Croatian singing company Davor. The other is the universal, which applies to every space of collective musical activity, enjoyment and friends, and is therefore known to anyone who has ever sung in a choir. And, both together, in this case, they do - "two stories about Davor". R .: Alexei Pavlovsky ... / Dvije priče o Davoru - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2023) Većini ljudi u Hrvatskoj vjerojatno nije poznato da je službena, unificirana verzija hrvatske himne "Lijepa naša domovino" prvi put javno izvedena u Slavonskom Brodu, 1896. godine, prigodom velike i svečane proslave 25. obljetnice Hrvatskog pjevačkog društva Davor. Društvo je osnovano 1871. godine, na valu već postojećeg i aktivnog europskog trenda zborskog pjevanja, pri čemu čak nije bilo ni prvo u Hrvatskoj. Riječ je, dakle, o kulturnoj pojavi koja u nas postoji kontinuirano više od 160 godina, a u nekim zemljama Europe i dulje. No, ta je povijest dio samo jedne od mogućih priča o Hrvatskom pjevačkom društvu Davor. Druga je ona univerzalna, koja vrijedi za svaki prostor kolektivnog glazbenog djelovanja, uživanja i prijateljevanja, pa je stoga poznata svakome tko je ikad pjevao u nekom zboru. A, jedna i druga zajedno, u ovom slučaju, čine - "Dvije priče o Davoru". R.: Aleksej Pavlovsky...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (artistic program, Croatia) famous Slovenian philosopher and sociologist Renata Salecl was a guest of the philosophical theater in Zagreb, so we took the opportunity to talk to the former members of the famous Ljubljana School of Psychoanalysis and today's professor at London School of Economics, researcher at the Institute of Criminology Professor at Birkbeck College. She is the author of the book "On Anxiety", "(per) version of love and hatred" and "Tyranian choice", and the reason for our conversation is the book "A Man is a Virus" translated from Slovenian by Anita Peta Stantic. Alfred Fischer was a Jew of Osijek, studied philosophy in Vienna, completed law in Zagreb, a lawyer who took refuge with his family in Hungary in 1941. In recent years of the war, they have been hiding in Budapest, and Alfred wrote down his political and philosophical reflections in the notebooks, describing life in Budapest before the end of the war. His daily records have now been published for the first time entitled: "For a few more days." Finally, the literary critic Dario Grgić takes us on a literary trip to Romania with the unconventional novel Mircea Cărtărescu "Nostalgia" who translated Luca-Ioan Fran, Marina Gessner and Ivana Olujic into Croatian ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Poznata slovenska filozofkinja i sociologinja Renata Salecl bila je gošća Filozofskog teatra u Zagrebu pa smo i mi iskoristili priliku za razgovor s nekadašnjom pripadnicom znamenite Ljubljanske škole psihoanalize a današnjom profesoricom na London School of Economics, istraživačicom pri Institutu za kriminologiju na Pravnom fakultetu u Ljubljani te profesoricom na Birkbeck Collegeu. Autorica je knjiga "O anksioznosti", "(Per)verzije ljubavi i mržnje" i "Tiranija izbora", a povod našem razgovoru je knjiga "Čovjek je čovjeku virus" koju je sa slovenskoga prevela Anita Peti Stantić. Alfred Fischer bio je osječki Židov, studirao je filozofiju u Beču, završio pravo u Zagrebu, odvjetnik koji se 1941 s obitelji sklonio u Mađarsku. Posljednjih godina rata skrivali su se u Budimpešti, a Alfred je u bilježnice zapisivao svoja politička i filozofska promišljanja, opisivao život u Budimpešti pred sam kraj rata. Njegovi dnevnički zapisi sada su prvi put objavljeni pod naslovom: "Još nekoliko dana". Za kraj književni kritičar Dario Grgić vodi nas na književno putovanje u Rumunjsku uz nekonvencionalni roman Mircea Cărtărescua "Nostalgija" koji su na hrvatski preveli Luca-Ioan Frana, Marina Gessner i Ivana Olujić...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) On the occasion of the 170th anniversary of the birth of Croatian -Italian composer Antoni Smareglie Croatian National Theater Ivan pl. Zajc in Rijeka sets his opera "Le Nozze Istriane", that is, "Istrian wedding". It is a co -production with the Istrian National Theater in the composer's native Pula, where the production premiered a few days before. Interesting is this physical closeness of the historic town of Vodnjan, where there is a shop on the tragic suffering of young man Lorenz, in love with Maruss. Smareglia is Istrian from the marriage of Croats and Italians a native of Vodnjan, who wrote in the spirit of Verism under the sensory influences of Wagner, and his works were premiered in large theaters in Milan, Venice, Vienna and New York. He is still unjustly neglected in the repertoire of Croatian theaters. We find out about the work and his contemporary reading through the prism of the current criticism of a woman's position in the provincial society from the testimonies of the latest interpreters, the singer of all roles at the premiere of May 11 this year (Anamarija Knego, Bože Jurić Pesic, Giorgio Surian, Filippo Pollineli, Stefany Findrik and Jure Pocky (Marin Blažević) Krecic) ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) U povodu 170. obljetnice rođenja hrvatsko-talijanskog skladatelja Antonija Smareglie Hrvatsko narodno kazalište Ivana pl. Zajca u Rijeci postavlja njegovu operu "Le nozze istriane", odnosno "Istarska svadba". Riječ je o koprodukciji s Istarskim narodnom kazalištem u skladateljevoj rodnoj Puli, gdje je produkcija premijerno uprizorena nekoliko dana prije. Zanimljiva je ta fizička neposredna blizina povijesnoga gradića Vodnjana, gdje je smještena radnja o tragičnom stradavanju mladića Lorenza, zaljubljenog u Marussu. Smareglia je Istrijan iz braka Hrvatice i Talijana rodom upravo iz Vodnjana, koji je pisao u duhu verizma pod osjetnim utjecajima Wagnera, te su mu djela praizvedena u velikim kazalištima u Milanu, Veneciji, Beču i New Yorku. I dalje je nepravedno zapostavljen u repertoaru hrvatskih kazališta. O djelu i njegovu suvremenom čitanju kroz prizmu aktualne kritike pozicije žene u provincijalnom društvu saznajemo iz svjedočanstava najnovijih interpreta, pjevača svih uloga na premijeri 11. svibnja ove godine (Anamarija Knego, Bože Jurić Pešić, Giorgio Surian, Filippo Pollineli, Stefany Findrik i Jure Počkaj), te redatelja (Marin Blažević) i dirigenta (Simon Krečić)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia) has been 60 years since David Murray, as a 10 -year -old, played the saxophone for the first time at a church in Baltimore, and half a century since he came to New York, establishing himself soon as one of the main heirs of the great saxophonist tradition of Jazz. After several hundred editions, their own or with greats old and new, Murray is still grounded in this tradition in an intimate contact with its roots: Gospel and Blues, respecting the directions in which his predecessors developed them. The recent period of Murray's work was marked by the collaboration with Norwegian musicians, the double bass player Ingbrigt Håker Flaten and drummer Paal Nilssen-Lale, prominent representatives of the Scandinavian jazz who are best known as the members of the Thing Mats Gustafsson. Murray performed with them in Zagreb at the end of November at the restart of the NO Jazz Festival in Zagreb's Lauba, showing that when the "Not only jazz" program was still rooting, they still have something to say ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Prošlo je 60 godina otkako je David Murray kao desetogodišnjak prvi put zasvirao saksofon u jednoj crkvi u Baltimoreu, a pola stoljeća otkako je došao u New York etablirajući se ubrzo kao jedan od glavnih baštinika velike saksofonističke tradicije jazza. Nakon nekoliko stotina izdanja, vlastitih ili s velikanima starim i novim, Murray je i dalje na najljepši način uzemljen u tu tradiciju, u intimnom doticaju s njezinim korijenjem: gospelom i bluesom, uvažavajući pritom smjerove u kojima su ih razvili njegovi prethodnici. Recentni je period Murrayjeva djelovanja obilježila suradnja s norveškim glazbencima, kontrabasistom Ingebrigtom Håkerom Flatenom i bubnjarom Paalom Nilssen-Loveom, istaknutim predstavnicima skandinavskog jazza koji su ovdašnjoj publici najpoznatiji kao članovi trija The Thing Matsa Gustafssona. Murray je s njima u Zagrebu nastupio potkraj studenog na ponovo pokrenutom NO Jazz Festivalu u zagrebačkoj Laubi pokazujući da, kada je program "not only jazz" korijeni još uvijek imaju što reći...

programme.title: The art of architecture / Umijeće arhitekture
programme.desc: The Art of Architecture - (E10, Educational Program, England, 2019) The Hall at the London Palace of Alexandra, which has been waiting for the audience for eighty years, was restored by architect Matt Somerville. The team from his bureau feilden Clegg Bradley decided to keep most of what they found - including the damage that arose while the BBC served as a storage for props. Result? Victorian theater adapted to today's needs, along with traces of stopped decay. R .: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator) ... / The Art of Architecture - (E10, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2019) Dvoranu u londonskoj palači Alexandra, koja je osamdeset godina čekala publiku, obnovio je arhitekt Matt Somerville. Ekipa iz njegova biroa Feilden Clegg Bradley odlučila je zadržati većinu onoga što su pronašli - uključujući i štetu koja je nastala dok je BBC-ju služila kao spremište za rekvizite. Rezultat? Viktorijansko kazalište prilagođeno današnjim potrebama, zajedno s tragovima zaustavljenog propadanja. R.: Alastair Layzell Ul.: Alastair Layzell (Narrator)...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Mundi Classics - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2021) Famous Argentine tenor Jose Cura performed on Orebic's waterfront on September 11, 2021, on the Peljesac Square Square, accompanied by the Dubrovnik Symphony Orchestra and with the sounds of artistic Argentine poems, created on the texts of famous poets, and the guitar is the Czechy of Barbora. MO. The girlfriend is a versatile artist and, as a top conductor, he staged many prestigious orchestras. His productions, such as Skella at the Colon Theater in Buenos Aires, Nabucca for the State Opera in Prague or Puccini's La Boheme for the Royal Swedish Opera, were rated as the most successful ever. In the concert dinner, he will perform in addition to Argentine songs and some of his most famous opera arias, and will be joined on stage by the national champion, soloist of the Croatian National Theater Ivan Pl. Zajc in Rijeka Kristina Kolar and young Serbian soprano Marija Jelic. He shares the conductor podium with Croatian conductor Marija Ramljak. R .: Mirena Stijačić ... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2021) Slavni argentinski tenor Jose Cura nastupio je na orebićkoj Rivi 11. rujna 2021., na Trgu peljeških jedara uz pratnju Dubrovačkog simfonijskog orkestra i uz zvuke umjetničkih argentinskih pjesama nastale na tekstove poznatih pjesnika, a solistica na gitari je Čehinja Barbora Kubíková. Mo. Cura je svestrani umjetnik te je kao vrhunski dirigent ravnao mnogim prestižnim orkestrima. Njegove produkcije, poput Otella u Teatru Colon u Buenos Airesu, Nabucca za Državnu operu u Pragu ili Puccinijeve La Boheme za Kraljevsku švedsku operu, ocijenjene su kao najuspješnije ikad. U koncertnoj večeri izvest će osim argentinskih pjesama i neke od svojih najpoznatijih opernih arija, a na pozornici će mu se pridružiti nacionalna prvakinja, solistica Opere HNK-a Ivana pl. Zajca u Rijeci Kristina Kolar te mlada srpska sopranistica Marija Jelić. Dirigentski podij dijeli s hrvatskom dirigenticom Marijom Ramljak. R.: Mirena Stijačić...

programme.desc: 60 years of Kajkavian Popevki Festival - (entertainment program, Croatia, 2025) The first two evenings of the Jubilee, the 60th Kajkavian Popevki Festival, as part of the traditional manifestation - Kajkavian Culture Week, remind us of the popular Kajkavian compositions. It will be a great performance of the festival orchestra and performers who gladly climb about our dear Kaja. The organizer is the Society for Kajkavian Cultural Creativity. The conductors are Josip Hrastic, Sinisa Leopold and Robert Mihovilic, head of the festival orchestra. Bit će to sjajne izvedbe festivalskog orkestra i izvođača koji rado popevaju o dragom nam kaju. Organizator je Društvo za kajkavsko kulturno stvaralaštvo. Dirigenti su Josip Hrastić, Siniša Leopold i Robert Mihovilić, šef festivalskog orkestra. R.: Vesna Fijačko Fodor...

programme.title: Ocean seen by heart / Ocean viđen srcem
programme.desc: Locean Vu du Coeur - (Doc. Film, Canada, 2023) It has long seemed to be unchanging and inexhaustible, but the impact of our procedures on his biodiversity and temperature has become alarming. In the ocean with a heart viewed, the continuation of the film, the Earth watched by heart, Hubert Reeves, surrounded by dedicated scientists and researchers, lower to us the dangers that threaten the oceans and, more than anything, shows their brilliant ability to renew. It is the celebration of life in the richest edition that reveals to us why we have to treat the ocean as our most precious and needed ally if, among other species, we want to survive on our Blue Planet. R .: Marie-Dominique Michaud ... / LOcean vu du coeur - (dok. film, Kanada, 2023) Dugo se činilo da je ocean nepromjenjiv i neiscrpan, ali utjecaj naših postupaka na njegovu biološku raznolikost i temperaturu postao je alarmantan. U Oceanu gledanom srcem, nastavku filma Zemlja gledana srcem, Hubert Reeves, okružen predanim znanstvenicima i istraživačima, niže nam opasnosti koje prijete oceanima i, više od svega, prikazuje njihovu sjajnu sposobnost obnavljanja. To je slavljenje života u najbogatijem izdanju koje nam otkriva zašto ocean moramo tretirati kao svojeg najdragocjenijeg i najpotrebnijeg saveznika ako, među ostalim vrstama, želimo opstati na našem modrom planetu. R.: Marie-Dominique Michaud...

programme.title: Family on the edge / Obitelj na rubu
programme.desc: Druzinica - (Drama, Slovenia, 2017) Focus is on the breakup of an idyllic relationship between parents, Mark and Dunja. It is a consequence of a lack of respect caused by a loss of work and a financial breakdown. Over time, parents can no longer bear a burden that increasingly affects their children. R .: Jan Cvitkovic Ul.: Primoz Vrhovec (Marko), Irena Kovacevic (Dunja), Miha Kosec (Taras), Ula Gulic (Mala), Borut Veselko (SEF) ... / Druzinica - (drama, Slovenija, 2017) Fokus je na raspadu idiličnog odnosa između roditelja, Marka i Dunje. Posljedica je to nedostatka poštovanja uzrokovanog gubitkom posla i financijskim slomom. S vremenom, roditelji više ne mogu podnijeti teret koji sve više utječe na njihovu djecu. R.: Jan Cvitkovic Ul.: Primož Vrhovec (Marko), Irena Kovacevic (Dunja), Miha Kosec (Taras), Ula Gulic (Mala), Borut Veselko (Sef)...

Series, Croatia, 2014) Viktor is the founder of mobile app development, Dijana Creative Director of Children's Workshops, Nancy actress, Eli designer, and Vedran salesman at the store. All of them went to a job conversation; Some in the role of the employer, others in the less thankful role of the employee. R .: Filip Peruzovic ... / Generacija Y - (S02, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2014) Viktor je osnivač tvrtke za razvoj mobilnih aplikacija, Dijana kreativna direktorica dječjih radionica, Nancy glumica, Eli dizajnerica, a Vedran prodavač u trgovini. Svi su oni prošli razgovor za posao; neki u ulozi poslodavca, ostali u manje zahvalnoj ulozi posloprimca. Saznat ćemo kako izgledaju ugodni, neugodni razgovori; što je bitno, a što ne za dobivanje posla iz snova - ako isti uopće postoji... R.: Filip Peruzović...

programme.title: Love rituals / Ljubavni rituali
programme.desc: Love Rites - (Film, France, 1987) Beautiful spring afternoon in Paris. Huga Arnold attracts a young woman he noticed on the feathering of the metro. He follows, he looks at her while he shifts his leg over his leg and wonder, "Is she a prostitute?" Miriam Gwen is an actress. Huga performs from the maze of underground corridors and leads him to the church of Saint Germain. Naive and perverted at the same time, she ignites him imagination, erotic games and promising touches. Because she is a master of art control male cravings ... R.: Walerian Borowczyk ul.: Mathieu Carrière (Hugo Arnold), Miriam Gwen), Josy Bernard (Mary), Isabelle Tinard (Nora Nix), Jacques Couderc ... / Love Rites - (film, Francuska, 1987) Prekrasno proljetno popodne u Parizu. Huga Arnolda privuče mlada žena koju primijeti na peronu metroa. Slijedi je, gleda je dok prebacuje nogu preko noge i pita se: "Je li ona prostitutka?" Miriam Gwen je glumica. Huga izvodi iz labirinta podzemnih hodnika metroa i vodi ga u crkvu Saint Germain. Naivna i perverzna istodobno, ona mu zapali maštu pričama, erotskim igrama i obećanjem dodira. Jer ona je majstorica umjetnosti kontrole muških žudnja... R.: Walerian Borowczyk Ul.: Mathieu Carrière (Hugo Arnold), Marina Pierro (Miriam Gwen), Josy Bernard (Meriem), Isabelle Tinard (Nora Nix), Jacques Couderc...

Druga je ona univerzalna, koja vrijedi za svaki prostor kolektivnog glazbenog djelovanja, uživanja i prijateljevanja, pa je stoga poznata svakome tko je ikad pjevao u nekom zboru. programme.title: Italian / Italiana
programme.desc: Italiana - (e02, nature. Film, Italy) In the Cinque Terre National Park, there is a story about the last stubborn ligurian farmers who have decided to learn to make terraceous gardens with drywalls. The result is in front of your eyes: a miracle in the interspace between the mountains and the sea. "Mountaineering Museum" Reinhold Messner was a full hit. His vision merged with the genius of the famous architects of Zahe Hadid, which enabled museum spaces to open in the mountains of South Tyrol. It shows another museum, "Lumen". Just a white and porous country like that in Altamura in the sunny Apulia could give bread and cheese in numerous shades of white. We re-discover timeless flavors and colors thanks to the new generation of cosmopolitan craftsmen. Palatin chapel in Palermo is a wonder that needs to be seen at least once in life. If you haven't done so yet, discover the chapel in the story of an internationally known art historian. Material and its end Can the material known all over the world have a soul that is so rooted in the end where it originated? The entrepreneurial genius of the family from Piedmont speaks Anna Zegna, the president of the foundation and this oasis in the province of Biella ... / Italiana - (E02, prirod. film, Italija) U Nacionalnom parku Cinque Terre postoji priča o petorici zadnjih tvrdoglavih ligurskih zemljoradnika koji su mlade doseljenike odlučili naučiti praviti terasaste vrtove sa suhozidima. Rezultat je pred vašim očima: čudo u međuprostoru između planine i mora. "Muzej planinarenja" Reinholda Messnera bio je pun pogodak. Njegova se vizija spojila s genijem slavne arhitektice Zahe Hadid koja je omogućila da se muzejski prostori otvore u planinama Južnog Tirola. To pokazuje još jedan muzej, "Lumen". Samo bijela i porozna zemlja poput one u Altamuri u sunčanoj Apuliji mogla je dati kruh i sir u mnogobrojnim nijansama bijele boje. Ponovno otkrivamo bezvremenske okuse i boje zahvaljujući novoj generaciji kozmopolitskih obrtnika. Palatinska kapela u Palermu čudo je koje treba vidjeti barem jedanput u životu. Ako to još niste učinili, kapelu otkrijte u priči međunarodno poznatog povjesničara umjetnosti. Materijal i njegov kraj Može li materijal poznat u cijelom svijetu imati dušu koja je toliko ukorijenjena u kraj u kojem je nastao? O poduzetničkom geniju obitelji iz Pijemonta govori Anna Zegna, predsjednica Zaklade i ove oaze u pokrajini Biella...

programme.title: Pan / Pan
programme.desc: The events of the film revolve within the framework of fantasy and adventures around an orphan and only boy who finds himself in the world of (Neverland), where wonders and myths are embodied in it, to find himself trapped between fun, and the extreme danger by a group of pirates led by (Black Bird), and (Hawk) also, to discover his fate that will make him (Peter Ban), the most famous boy, at all And the hero (Neverland) is the bracelet. / تدور أحداث الفيلم في إطار من الفانتازيا والمغامرات حول فتى يتيم ووحيد يجد نفسه بعالم (نيفرلاند)، حيث العجائب والأساطير تتجسد فيه، ليجد نفسه محاصرا بين المرح، والخطر الشديد من قِبَل مجموعة من القراصنة بقيادة (بلاك بيرد)، و(هوك) أيضًا، ليكتشف بعد ذلك مصيره الذي سيجعله (بيتر بان)، الفتى الأشهر على الإطلاق، وبطل (نيفرلاند) المغوار.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire / The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the "Hunger Games" trilogy, in which we follow the events that take place in the dark future society; In which every region is forced to make a sacrifice in the form of a boy or teenage girl to participate in a TV program on the air to enjoy the masters; Where they are forced to fight to death in order to enhance the people ... but the signs of a revolution waving on the horizon, so what happens? / الجزء الثاني من ثلاثية "ألعاب الجوع"، نتابع فيه الأحداث التي تجري في المجتمع المستقبلي المظلم؛ الذي يُجبر فيه كل أقليم على تقديم أضحية في صورة صبي أو فتاة مراهقة للمشاركة في برنامج تلفزيوني على الهواء لإمتاع السادة؛ حيث يتم إراغمهم على القتال حتى الموت من أجل تسلية علية القوم.. لكن إرهاصات ثورة تلوح في الأفق، فماذا يحدث؟

programme.title: Sucker Punch / Sucker Punch

programme.desc: (Krishna) is a fun brother who loves his brother and always stands beside them, especially his older brother (Chero), who is doing his best to maintain his safety and protect him from any harm, then his life turns upside down when circumstances force him to marry Habiba (Chero). / (كريشنا) هو أخ مرح محب لشقيقيه ويقف بجانبهما دائمًا، وبالأخص شقيقه الأكبر (تشيرو) الذي يبذل قصارى جهده للحفاظ على سلامته وحمايته من أي مكروه، ثم تنقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب عندما تجبره الظروف على الزواج من حبيبة (تشيرو).

programme.title: The Unfaithful S2 / The Unfaithful S2
programme.desc: In the second part, (Asia) decided to stay away from (Tikerdag) and travel to Istanbul to build a new life with her son (Ali) after what happened with her husband, but she meets (Aras) who is on his way to (Tikiradag). / في الجزء الثاني، تقرر (آسيا) الابتعاد عن (تيكيرداغ) والسفر إلى إسطنبول لبناء حياة جديدة مع ابنها (علي) بعد ما حدث مع زوجها، ولكنها تلتقي بـ(أراس) الذي يتعرض لحادث في طريقه إلى (تيكيرداغ).

programme.title: Full / كامل العدد
programme.desc: When Ahmed, the plastic surgeon, and Layla, who has a cosmetic project, quickly meets each other, but their various family circumstances standing in an obstacle to the relationship, but they decide to marry and challenge the circumstances. / عندما يتقابل أحمد طبيب التجميل، وليلى صاحبة مشروع مستحضرات التجميل سرعان ما يقعا في غرام بعضهما البعض، ولكن ظروفهما العائلية المختلفة تقف سببا عائقا أمام العلاقة، ولكنهما يقررا الزواج وتحدي الظروف.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah
programme.desc: Farah works illegally cleaning in Istanbul after escaping from Iran, then she tries to travel to France and take care of her young son, but her life turns upside down when she witnesses a murder in her workplace, then she tries to escape from the perpetrators of the crime after getting to know her. / تعمل (فرح) عاملة نظافة بشكل غير قانوني في إسطنبول بعد فرارها من إيران، ثم تحاول السفر إلى فرنسا والاعتناء بابنها الصغير، لكن تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب عندما تشهد جريمة قتل في مكان عملها، ثم تحاول الهرب من مرتكبي الجريمة بعد تعرفهم عليها.

programme.title: I am free / أنا حرة
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, Nour is experiencing a harsh marriage experience with a narcissistic man who imposes psychological and physical violence. Soon her personal battle turns into a conflict with the entire society, after the husband tightened his control over the daughter, Farah, by virtue of having the right to custody. And between pain and hope, Nour continues her hard search for dignity and freedom. / في إطار درامي، تخوض نور تجربة زواج قاسية مع رجل نرجسي يفرض عليها العنف النفسي والجسدي. وسرعان ما تتحول معركتها الشخصية إلى صراع مع المجتمع بأسره، بعدما أحكم الزوج سيطرته على الابنة فرح بحكم امتلاكه حق الحضانة. وبين الألم والأمل، تواصل نور بحثها الشاق عن الكرامة والحرية.

programme.title: Wild Heart S2 / Wild Heart S2
programme.desc: In the second season, after the meeting of all family members under one roof, (Yaman) reveals the real intentions (Sarhan), and faces a dangerous opponent, and he seeks to secure the future of his loved ones. / في الموسم الثاني وبعد اجتماع جميع أفراد العائلة تحت سقف واحد، يكشف (يامان) نوايا (سرحان) الحقيقية، ويواجه خصما خطيرا، فيسعى لتأمين مستقبل أحبائه.

programme.title: Dunk / Dunk
programme.desc: The series revolves around a university, where the student Amal accuses her professor of harassing her, thus receiving support from all around her, but we discover that all of this is part of a plan that the student has orphaned to save her fiancé from great trouble. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إحدى الجامعات، حيث تتهم الطالبة أمل أستاذها بالتحرش بها وبذلك تلقى الدعم من جميع من حولها، ولكن نكتشف أن كل هذا هو جزء من خطة قد دبرتها الطالبة لإنقاذ خطيبها من ورطة كبيرة.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees
programme.desc: In a framework of crime and drama, and after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by providing several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.title: Break bond / كسر عضم
programme.desc: The ruling facilitates the illegal smuggling of its power and its many relationships by the corrupt policemen, despite his son, Ryan, the police officer who is tackling outlaws. / يقوم الحكم بتيسير عمليات التهريب الغير شرعية لسلطته وعلاقاته العديدة من قبل رجال الشرطة الفاسدين، على الرغم من ابنه ريان ضابط الشرطة الذي يقوم بالتصدي للخارجين عن القانون.

programme.title: Prince / البرنس
programme.desc: Within the framework of social drama, the series revolves around the Prince's family, where Radwan Al -Prince, who shares many social family relations between him and his family, after the death of his parents, and finds himself responsible for everyone. / في إطار الدراما الاجتماعية تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عائلة البرنس، حيث رضوان البرنس الذي يتشارك في العديد من العلاقات الأسرية الاجتماعية بينه وبين عائلته، وذلك بعد وفاة والديه، ويجد نفسه متولي مسئولية الجميع.

programme.title: My dear father / والدي العزيز
programme.desc: A failed love story ends with the separation of a man and a woman and their departure from each other, but when they meet again after many years, this love story returns to open its doors again. / تنتهي قصة حب فاشلة بانفصال رجل وامرأة وابتعادهما عن بعضهما البعض، ولكن حينما يتقابلان من جديد بعد سنوات عديدة، تعود قصة الحب تلك لتفتح أبوابها من جديد.

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where fate leads two friends close to marriage to the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Nun Al -Niswa / نون النسوة
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events of the series gathered five friends, gathering the paths of life, and their problems and dreams spread, and each of them tries to support the other until they reach safety after a group of disappointments that struck them. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي تجمع أحداث المسلسل خمس صديقات، تجمعهن دروب الحياة، فيتشاركن مشاكلهن، وأحلامهن، وتحاول كلا منهن مساندة الأخرى حتى يصلن إلى بر الأمان بعد مجموعة خيبات ضربت بهن.

programme.title: Layalina 80 / ليالينا ٨٠
programme.desc: The events revolve around the eighties of Hisham's life, who returns from work in the Gulf and his life changes after a car accident that his beautiful daughter is exposed to the driver, Radi, and begins to notice what he does not know about his wife, Maryam. / تدور الأحداث في الثمانينات حول حياة هشام، الذي يعود من العمل بالخليج وتتغير حياته بعد حادث سيارة تتعرض له ابنته جميلة مع السائق راضي، ويبدأ في ملاحظة ما لا يعلمه عن زوجته مريم.

programme.title: Abu Al Banat / أبو البنات
programme.desc: The father tries to deal with the challenges of daily life with his daughters and do a lot of love and sacrifice for them, but destiny reveals what his sister Marim did in the past, as one of his daughters changed the son of the wedding singer Laila for a goal in herself. / يحاول أب التعامل مع تحديات الحياة اليومية مع بناته وبذل الكثير من الحب والتضحية من أجلهن، ولكن القدر يكشف ما فعلته شقيقته مرايم بالماضي حيث بدلت إحدى بناته بابن مطربة الأفراح ليلى لغاية في نفسها.

programme.title: Life today / Hayat Bugun
programme.desc: The chief physician (Paris Jovinner) is appointed at Haysarono Hospital, in Istanbul, where the hospital is going through a difficult time, where (Paris) is trying to restart the hospital, and is fighting a difficult battle for his patients and colleagues. / يُعين كبير الأطباء (باريس جوفينر) في مستشفى (هيسارونو)، في إسطنبول، حيث تمر المستشفى بوقت عصيب، حيث يحاول (باريس) إعادة تشغيل المستشفى، ويخوض معركة صعبة من أجل مرضاه وزملائه.

programme.title: Golden Boy / Golden Boy
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where (Hallis Agha), one of the pillars of the established families in the city of (Gaziantep), decides to marry his riotous grandson (Farid), then the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقرر (هاليس آغا)، وهو أحد أعمدة العائلات الراسخة في مدينة (غازي عنتاب)، تزويج حفيده المشاغب (فريد)، ثم تتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Testament betrayal / خيانة عهد
programme.desc: (Ahed) A wealthy lady, who owns a clothing factory, a large family, who plays reading the cup in which she was characterized by dangerous and critical turns in her personal and family life, and there is a conspiracy that is being woven from her closest relatives. / (عهد) سيدة ثرية، تمتلك مصنعًا للملابس، وهى كبيرة أسرتها، تلعب قراءة الفنجان التي تميزت فيها منذ الصغر منعطفات خطيرة وحرجة في حياتها الشخصية واﻷسرية، كما أن هناك مؤامرة تحاك لها من أقرب اﻷقربين لها.

programme.title: Life today / Hayat Bugun
programme.desc: The chief physician (Paris Jovinner) is appointed at Haysarono Hospital, in Istanbul, where the hospital is going through a difficult time, where (Paris) is trying to restart the hospital, and is fighting a difficult battle for his patients and colleagues. / يُعين كبير الأطباء (باريس جوفينر) في مستشفى (هيسارونو)، في إسطنبول، حيث تمر المستشفى بوقت عصيب، حيث يحاول (باريس) إعادة تشغيل المستشفى، ويخوض معركة صعبة من أجل مرضاه وزملائه.

programme.title: Boxing Girls C1 / بنات الملاكمة ج1
programme.desc: The series tells the story of an ambitious young Saudi girl working to open a gym in Saudi Arabia, and begins training young Saudi women in boxing arts and secrets. / يروي المسلسل قصة فتاة شابة سعودية طموحة تعمل على افتتاح صالة ألعاب رياضية في السعودية، وتبدأ في تدريب النساء السعوديات الشابات على فنون الملاكمة وأسرارها.

programme.title: Beirut batch / دفعة بيروت
programme.desc: The events take place in the sixties of the last century, where a group of students travel to Beirut to study there at the university, and a number of exciting events are located. / تدور الأحداث في ستينيات القرن الماضي، حيث مجموعة من الطلاب يسافرون إلى بيروت ليدرسون هناك بالجامعة، وتقع لهم عدد من الأحداث المثيرة.في لبنان عام 1964، ويجد مجموعة منهم أنفسهم في دوامة من الأفكار والطموحات المتناقضة والعادات المختلفة... وفي شباك الحب.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorted to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim from cancer, so he agreed to spend one night with the company manager Zain for an amount of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.

programme.title: Nile Palace / قصر النيل
programme.desc: The events revolve around the life of Camellia, whose father is killed after his fight with the aristocrat Fahmy Al -Suwaifi during her childhood, and Camellia returns after years to take revenge on the sons of Al -Suwaifi. / تدور الأحداث حول حياة كاميليا التي يُقتل والدها بعد شجاره مع الأرستقراطي فهمي السيوفي أثناء طفولتها، وتعود كاميليا بعد سنوات للانتقام من أبناء عائلة السيوفي.

programme.title: disappearance / اختفاء
programme.desc: The events revolve around a university doctor in Russia, and she lives with her husband there, but suddenly and without introductions her husband disappears, to start the journey of searching for him, and it comes to returning to Egypt as part of her research journey, but this trip surprises her with many things that she was not aware of. / تدور الأحداث حول دكتورة جامعية في روسيا، وتعيش مع زوجها هناك، لكن فجأة وبدون مقدمات يختفي زوجها، لتبدأ رحلة البحث عنه، ويصل بها الأمر للعودة إلى مصر في إطار رحلة بحثها، لكن هذه الرحلة تفاجئها بالكثير من الأمور التي لم تكن على علم بها.

programme.title: For a cat / لمعي القط
programme.desc: The series revolves around a bus driver (Mohamed Imam) in a private school, and while the driver returns the students to their homes after the end of the school day, one of the parents kidnaps the school bus and requests a great ransom. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول سائق أتوبيس (محمد إمام) فى أحد المدارس الخاصة، وأثناء إعادة السائق التلاميذ لمنازلهم بعد إنتهاء اليوم الدراسي، يختطف أحد أولياء الأمور أتوبيس المدرسة ويطلب فدية كبيرة.

programme.title: A man and six stat c 1 / راجل وست ستات ج1
programme.desc: Adel's suffering continues at his home as a result of his livelihood under one roof with 6 women: his wife, daughter, sister, sister's sister, mother and mother -in -law, in addition to his suffering with the symbolic employee who works for him in the bazaar he owns. / تستمر معاناة عادل في منزله من جراء عيشه تحت سقف واحد مع 6 نساء: زوجته وابنته وشقيقته وشقيقة زوجته ووالدته وحماته، باﻹضافة لمعاناته مع رمزي الموظف الغبي الذي يعمل لديه في البازار الذي يملكه.

قام صبري بتحريض بعض أصدقاءه، للإعتداء على عمر، الذى تحمل الضرب، وطلب من نسمة الهروب، فإستقلت سيارة المعتدين، وفرت هاربة، ولكنها فقدت السيطرة على عجلة القيادة، فإنقلبت بها السيارة، وتم نقل نسمة وعمر للمستشفي. أصيبت نسمة بإنهيار عصبي، لشعورها بعدم الأمان، بعد أن عجز عمر عن حمايتها، وتم اللجوء للطبيب النفسي شبراوي عظيمه (محمد ثروت)، الذى نصح بعودة نسمة لمنزل الزوجية، غير أن نسمة شاهدت فيلم الجزيرة، وإنبهرت ببطله القوي منصور الحفني (أحمد السقا)، وتناست الواقع الحقيقي، ودخلت شرنقة البطل، وفرضت واقع إفتراضي، حيث رأت زوجها عمر، كأنه منصور الحفني. تم اللجوء للفنان أحمد السقا، عن طريق الصحفية نادين شوكت (نور قدري)، شقيقة نسمة، التى عرفتهم بالفنان، والذى تفهم الموقف، ووافق على الدخول فى تمثيلية، يتغلب فيها عمر عليه، ونجحت الخطة، وعادت نسمة لطبيعتها فى أحضان زوجها عمر. بينما أقام ابراهيم صديق عمر، علاقة حب مع نادين، التى كانت عازفة عن الإرتباط برجل، وتقدم ابراهيم لخطبتها، ورفض والدها. وأثناء رحلة بحرية، سقطت نسمة فى الماء، وعجز عمر عن إنقاذها، لعدم إجادته للسباحة، وتولي بحارة اللنش إنقاذها، وإنتكست نسمة، التى شاهدت مسلسل كلبش، وانبهرت بشخصية الضابط سليم الأنصاري (أمير كرارة)، وتخيلته فى صورة زوجها عمر. أراد شبراوي عظيمة، أن يحطم الأسد سليم الأنصاري بأسد آخر، وهو الفنان أحمد عز فى فيلم الخلية، ولكن لم تفلح المحاولة، ولجأ الطبيب عظيمة، لنظرية الخلخلة النفسية، وإستعان بالفنان كرارة، ليشرك عمر فى معركة ضد الإرهابيين، حيث يظهر عمر بطلاً، ونجحت الخطة، وعادت نسمة لطبيعتها فى أحضان زوجها عمر. غير أن الست هناء (بدرية طلبة) والدة عمر، دعت الجميع لقضاء يوم فى بانوراما السخنة، وتناول أكلة سمك، ثم ركوب التريفليك، وتعرضت نسمة للسقوط من إرتفاع، وتعلقت بباب التريفليك، وعجز عمر عن إنقاذها، وسقطت من إرتفاع لتستقبلها الوسائد الهوائية، وتنتكس للمرة الثالثة، وتم منعها من مشاهدة التليفزيون، غير أنها تمكنت من مشاهدة مسلسل رحيم، وتأثرت بالبطل (ياسر جلال)، ورأته بطلها وحاميها، فى صورة زوجها عمر، ورفض ياسر جلال أن يشارك فى خدعة، حيث رأي أن نسمة يجب أن ترى البطل الحقيقي داخل زوجها، وليس البطل المزيف الذى يواجهها به، وتشعر أنه الرجل الذى يستطيع أن يحميها بجد، وإلا يبقي لا يستحقها، فقرر عمر الانفصال عن نسمة، وفاتح والدها فى الأمر، والذى رحب بفكرة الطلاق، غير أن حريق شب بالفيللا، وإحتجزت نسمة بالدور العلوي، وسارع عمر لإنقاذها، ونجح فى إقتحام ألسنة اللهب، وأنقذ زوجته من موت محقق، ورأت نسمة فى زوجها عمر البطل، الذى يستطيع حمايتها، وتم شفاءها وعودتها لأحضان زوجها عمر، وتقدم ابراهيم للزواج من نادين، التى أجبرت والدها على الموافقة. إكتشف عمر أن ياسر جلال هو الذى أشعل النار فى الفيللا، ليتيح له الفرصة، ليظهر معدنه الحقيقي. (سبع البرمبه)

programme.title: Coercion / زواج بالإكراه
programme.desc: (Laila) A wealthy young man who is exposed to a traffic accident, which is bleeding and needs a quick blood transfusion, coincides with the blood type of her blood type with her private driver's blood, he transports blood to her without knowing that he himself is sick with AIDS and the disease moves to her, the young woman's life turns into misery and waiting for death, and she loves a new young man in her father's company named (Ahmed), but he does not exchange love; Because he loves (Hind), which he is about to marry, her father (Saeed Al -Koumi) threatens him to kill his fiancée and relatives in order to force him to marry his sick daughter with AIDS, and the events continue. / (ليلى) شابّة ثرية تتعرَّض لحادثة مرورية تنزف إثرها وتحتاج إلى نقل دم سريع، يتصادف أن تتطابق فصيلة دمها مع فصيلة دم سائقها الخاص، ينقل لها دمًا منه دون أن يعلم أنه هو نفسه مريض بالإيدز وينتقل إليها المرض، تنقلب حياة الشابة إلى تعاسة وانتظار للموت، وتحب شابًّا جديدًا في شركة أبيها اسمه (أحمد)، لكنه لا يبادلها الحب؛ لأنه يحب (هند) التي هو على وشك الزواج بها، يقوم والدها (سعيد الكومي) بتهديده بقتل خطيبته وأقاربه حتى يجبره على الزواج من ابنته المريضة بالإيدز، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: My heart and key / قلبي ومفتاحه
programme.desc: A divorced woman seeks to return to her husband for her young son by finding a man who plays the role of the (analyst), then she meets by chance a driver in one of the private transport applications while he is not married, and he is marrying him to resolve her crisis, without revealing to him her true motivation to marry him. / تسعى امرأة مطلقة للعودة إلى زوجها من أجل ابنها الصغير عن طريق إيجاد رجل يقوم بدور الـ(مُحلل)، ثم تلتقي عن طريق الصدفة بسائق في إحدى تطبيقات النقل الخاص وهو غير متزوج، وتعرض عليه الزواج لحل أزمتها، دون أن تكشف له عن دافعها الحقيقي للزواج منه.

program / برنامج

programme.desc: One of the most important talk shows began to broadcast in 2006 with Moataz Al -Demerdash and Reham Al -Sahli, but in 2011 the journalist Amr Al -Laithi joined the program after Al -Demerdash withdrew from his presentation. The program is concerned with important news and daily events that revolve in the Egyptian and Arab street, as well as monitor the interests, opinions and aspirations of viewers, as well as many guests from politicians, media and economics. / أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد.

The program is concerned with important news and daily events that revolve in the Egyptian and Arab street, as well as monitor the interests, opinions and aspirations of viewers, as well as many guests from politicians, media and economics. / أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.title: Persia without permissibility / فارس بلا جواز
programme.desc: Through separate connected episodes, the series revolves when Faris is exposed to some circumstances outside his Jordanian, which compels him to search for a bride. / من خلال حلقات متصلة منفصلة، تدور أحداث المسلسل عندما يتعرض فارس لبعض الظروف الخارجة عن إرداته، والتي تجبره للبحث عن عروس.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: peacock / الطاووس
programme.desc: Kamal the fleet is a veteran lawyer interested in compensation cases, but the conditions compel him to investigate one of the rape cases that turn his life upside down. / كمال الأسطول محامي مخضرم مهتم بقضايا التعويضات، ولكن الظروف تضطره كي يحقق في إحدى قضايا اﻻغتصاب التي تقلب حياته رأسا على عقب.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

The secret of the earth / سر الأرض
programme.desc: The events of the series (which continued to be filmed and displayed for several years) revolve around a group of comic situations, reviewing the importance and preservation of the land, and aims to spread awareness, advice, information about agriculture and its concern, in addition to other agricultural projects (such as animal raising), and to provide this information to the peasant category, with the aim of helping them to complete their important and necessary profession for society. / تدور أحداث المسلسل (والذي استمر تصويره وعرضه لعدة سنوات) حول مجموعة من المواقف الكوميدية، تستعرض أهمية الأرض والحفاظ عليها، ويهدف إلى نشر التوعية والنصائح والمعلومات الخاصة بالزراعة وما يخصها، بالإضافة إلى المشروعات الزراعية الأخرى (مثل تربية الحيوانات)، وتقديم هذه المعلومات لفئة الفلاحين، بهدف إعانتهم على استكمال مهنتهم الهامة، والضرورية للمجتمع.

programme.desc: (Ibtisam Al -Bustani) is a television broadcaster, married to the businessman (Karim Abu Al -Ezz), showing her first husband (Mustafa Qura) again, who thought he died in a bombing accident in Lebanon during the civil war, and discovers that he did not die in the accident and that he was a arms dealer and fled after he had a bombing with a large wealth. / (ابتسام البستاني) مذيعة تلفزيونية، متزوجة من رجل الأعمال (كريم أبو العز)، يظهر من جديد زوجها اﻷول (مصطفى قورة) الذي ظنت أنه توفي في حادث تفجير في لبنان أثناء الحرب الأهلية، وتكتشف أنه لم يمت بالحادث وأنه كان تاجر سلاح وهرب بعد اصابته بعملية التفجير مع ثروة كبيرة.

Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.title: Disobedience c 1 / العصيان ج1
programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.title: Deviation / انحراف
programme.desc: The series is taken from real events, which revolve in a teaser drama full of mystery, about the deviation of a number of personalities from human nature; They collide with a psychiatrist and decide to adjust the path in its own way. / المسلسل مأخوذ عن أحداث حقيقية، تدور فى دراما تشويقية مليئة بالغموض، حول انحراف عدد من الشخصيات عن الطبيعة البشرية؛ يصطدمون بطبيبة نفسية وتقرر تعديل المسار بطريقتها الخاصة.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Word of men / كلام رجالة
programme.desc: The series deals with five stories of five women, including the working woman, the woman of society, the important wife of the man, and the corrupt lawyer, but what they collected is that they have replaced their husbands in managing home and family affairs, to decide to gather every Tuesday a week, discuss the problems of each of them, and try to solve them. / يتناول المسلسل خمس قصص لخمس نساء، منهن المرأة العاملة، وسيدة المجتمع، وزوجة الرجل المهم، وحرم المحامي الفاسد، ولكن ما جمعهن هو أنهن حللن محل أزواجهن في إدارة شئون البيت والأسرة، ليقررن التجمع كل يوم ثلاثاء في الأسبوع، ومناقشة مشاكل كل واحدة منهن، ومحاولة حلها.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.
